Build SAINT input from a SummarizedExperiment

Source: R/summarized_experiment.R
se_to_saint_input.Rd

Converts a SummarizedExperiment with preys in rows and affinity purifications (IPs) in columns into the SAINT input list used by run_saint(). For a QFeatures object, pass one of its assays, for example qf[["proteins"]].

Usage

se_to_saint_input(
  se,
  assay = 1L,
  baitId = "baitId",
  CorT = "CorT",
  preyGeneId = "preyGeneId"
)

Arguments

se

A SummarizedExperiment with row and column names. The row names become preyId, the column names ipId.

assay

Name or index of the assay with spectral counts or intensities.

baitId

Name of the colData column with the bait of each IP.

CorT

Name of the colData column marking test ("T") and control ("C") IPs.

preyGeneId

Name of the rowData column with the gene name of each prey.

Value

A named list with the data frames inter, prey and bait.

Details

Entries that are NA or not positive count as not observed and are left out of inter.

See also

saint_scores_to_se()

Examples

counts <- matrix(
    c(20, 1, 18, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1),
    nrow = 2,
    dimnames = list(c("Prey1", "Prey2"), c("IP1", "IP2", "IP3", "IP4"))
)
se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = counts),
    rowData = data.frame(preyGeneId = c("Gene1", "Gene2")),
    colData = data.frame(
        baitId = c("BaitA", "BaitA", "Ctrl", "Ctrl"),
        CorT = c("T", "T", "C", "C")
    )
)
si <- se_to_saint_input(se)
run_saint(si, mode = "spc")
#>    Bait  Prey PreyGene  Spec SpecSum AvgSpec NumReplicates ctrlCounts AvgP MaxP
#> 1 BaitA Prey1    Gene1 20|18      38      19             2        1|0    1    1
#> 2 BaitA Prey2    Gene2   1|1       2       1             2        1|1    0    0
#>   TopoAvgP TopoMaxP SaintScore logOddsScore FoldChange BFDR boosted_by
#> 1        1        1          1        24.22         38    0           
#> 2        0        0          0        -1.99          1    0
